explanation: A-2I has rows (3,-3,-7), (-3,3,5), and (2,-2,-4). Its second column is the negative of its first, while the first two rows are independent, so its rank is 2 and nullity is 1. Thus eigenvalue 2 has one size-2 Jordan block. Eigenvalue 4 has one size-1 block, giving option b. The blocks may be reordered.
